action: NoMachine advises: do not install the package and delete it if downloaded in the affected window; if it was installed, disconnect the machine, change passwords from a clean device and reinstall the operating system.
date_note: NoMachine's advisory is dated 20 November (updated 23 November); the affected downloads fell on 19 and 20 November.
exec: Anyone who downloaded the NoMachine Personal Edition for Windows installer in the window NoMachine specifies may have received a tampered file, according to NoMachine.
geo_basis: organisation headquarters as stated in the NoMachine advisory (Luxembourg); no city given in the sources
plain: NoMachine says a download server for its Windows Personal Edition installer was compromised and the installer was altered. People who downloaded it in the window NoMachine specifies should not install it.
summary: NoMachine says a Windows Personal Edition installer on one of its download servers was altered to add malicious components, and that the compromise happened at its hosting provider, not through a flaw in its code, so the altered file came through a supplier. Only downloads of one installer file, nomachine-personal-edition_10.2.3_1_x64.exe, in a stated window are affected. NoMachine says it reported the incident to local authorities and its investigation is ongoing.
title: NoMachine says Windows Personal Edition installer on its download server was altered with malicious code

validation.note: Primary: NoMachine's own advisory plus CSIRT Italia's bulletin (a government CERT), both read.

review.note: Compared title, date, window, file name, hosting-provider statement, authority report and advice against NoMachine advisory and CSIRT Italia bulletin
